goal.original: You made some mistake and sent an order your son's address in Washington DC, and you want to modify it to your default address in Charlotte instead (you do not want to mention it, but it is in your user profile the agent can look up) because he is coming back home. You also want to adjust the desk lamp to be black color, and the backpack to be medium size and polyester material instead. If multiple colors are available for the backpack, you prefer grey. If the agent asks for payment method, you say gift card initially, but when the agent asks you to confirm before proceeding, you change your mind to using PayPal, and also decide to only modify the backpack. Make sure you briefly mention the two things at the same time at the beginning, but first mention the modification then the address.

timeline.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hey, how's it going? Yeah, hi, I'm contacting you about an order I placed. I've got a couple of things I wanted to modify. First off, I need to change the address on the order. It's currently set to my son's place in Washington DC, but he's coming back home soon, so I want to update it to my default address here in Charlotte. And also, I'd like to adjust the desk lamp to be black and the backpack to medium size and made of polyester instead. If the backpack comes in multiple colors, could you please get me a grey one?

Hello! I'd be happy to help you modify your order. Before I can assist you with any changes, I need to authenticate your identity first.

Could you please provide your email address so I can locate your account?
Sure, let me see here. Hmm, I'm not sure I have my email address handy right now. Could you maybe check the order number or something else that might help?

I understand you don't have your email handy. I can help you locate your account using your name and zip code instead.

Could you please provide:
- Your first name
- Your last name  
- Your zip code

This will help me find your account and then we can proceed with modifying your order.
Absolutely, no problem. My name is Ivan Khan and my zip code is 28243. Okay so, that should be it. Let's get this sorted out.
Great! I found your account, Ivan. Now let me look up your recent orders to help you with the modifications you mentioned.
